name: reference-cartpole-deterministic-replay
scope: one declared controller decision and one source plant transition per record

episode_inputs_required.plant_initial_state: four little-endian float64 values plus initial step_count and max_steps field
episode_inputs_required.controller_initial_grid: [1,32,32,6] little-endian float32 snapshot, external artifact or supplied fixture
episode_inputs_required.weights: local pinned checkpoint identity or synthetic fixture; checkpoint bytes remain ignored/restricted
episode_inputs_required.cross_episode_reset: explicit caller choice; never inferred by replay
episode_inputs_required.schedule: per-decision 50-59 count and exact ordered per-epoch mask trace
episode_inputs_required.noise: exact optional float32 array per epoch; absent means no update noise
episode_inputs_required.damage: if later enabled, exact placement and draw arrays must be declared; not implicit in E01 wrapper

mask_encoding.hash: SHA-256 over packed mask bits in epoch order

hash_serialization.plant: SHA-256 of four C-order little-endian float64 values
hash_serialization.controller: SHA-256 of C-order little-endian float32 grid; optional read-only backend trace
hash_serialization.noise: SHA-256 of C-order little-endian float32 array when present

comparison.same_runtime: exact action, trace, plant and controller hashes from identical inputs/draws
comparison.cross_runtime_float: use P03 declared full-array tolerance; do not assume NumPy byte hashes transfer across arithmetic runtimes
comparison.future_fixed_point: P07 scheduled golden model owns bit-exact RTL comparison, not this float wrapper

horizon.long_duration_diagnostic: separate 30000-action capped reconstruction; never silently substitute for released protocol
